name: Chesapeake Bay Bridge Viewpoint
description: Dramatic bridge silhouette against dawn colors. Perfect for wide-angle shots.
tips: Arrive 30 minutes before sunrise. Bring a wide lens.

name: Chincoteague Wildlife Refuge
description: Wild ponies grazing in marshland. Iconic Eastern Shore imagery.
tips: Telephoto lens recommended. Stay on designated trails.

name: Shenandoah National Park Overlook
description: Panoramic valley views from Skyline Drive. Layered mountains at golden hour.
tips: Best in fall for color. Bring a tripod for stability.

name: Assateague Island Beach
description: Wild horses on pristine dunes. Atlantic surf in background.
tips: Approach horses slowly. Respect their space.

name: Middleburg Countryside
description: Rolling horse country with fences and mist. Classic Virginia scene.
tips: Foggy mornings in autumn are magical. Explore side roads.

name: Great Falls Potomac River
description: Dramatic waterfalls and rapids. Powerful water movement.
tips: Use fast shutter to freeze water. ND filter helpful.

name: Luray Caverns
tips: High ISO needed. No tripods allowed. Steady hands required.

name: Vineyard at Sunset
description: Vine rows leading to sunset. Wine country romance.
tips: Ask permission before entering private vineyards.
